claim_text: Octopus says it detected abnormal activity in its systems in a cyberattack on the morning of Nov 27, 2026
summary: Octopus Cards Limited says it detected abnormal activity in its systems in a cyberattack on the morning of Nov 27, 2026, and acted at once to contain it.
detail: This is the company's own description in its press release of Nov 27. It has not said how the attackers got in.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Octopus press release, Nov 27: "In the morning of 27 November, Octopus Cards Limited ('Octopus') detected abnormal activity in its systems in a cyberattack incident and immediately took action to contain the incident."

claim_text: Personal information of about 7,500 customers is involved, including names and photographs; no credit card or bank account information
summary: Octopus says about 7,500 customers' names and photographs are involved; for some, Automatic Add Value Service details (bank code and top-up amount) may be too. No credit card or bank account information is affected.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Octopus press release: "personal information of approximately 7 500 customers, including names and photographs"; some may have had AAVS information involved, "but no credit card or bank account information is affected."

claim_text: Contact details of about 22,000 merchants are also affected
summary: Octopus says information on about 22,000 merchants is also affected: their contact persons' names, job titles, email addresses and phone numbers.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Octopus press release: "information relating to approximately 22,000 merchants is also affected, including merchants' contact persons' names, titles, email addresses and telephones."

claim_text: Octopus cards, Mobile Octopus and Octopus Wallet keep working; a few features may be temporarily affected
summary: Octopus says its cards, Mobile Octopus and Octopus Wallet remain safe to use and core services run normally. It has found no financial loss to customers. A few features may be temporarily affected by its precautions.
detail: The company has not said which features are affected.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Octopus press release: "Octopus core services continue to operate normally. As a result of the preventive measures taken, a small number of features may be temporarily affected." No customer financial loss identified to date.

claim_text: Octopus is investigating, keeping the relevant authorities informed, and will contact affected customers by email or SMS
summary: Octopus says it is conducting a thorough investigation, is keeping the relevant authorities informed and will update its assessment. Affected customers will be contacted directly by email or SMS.
detail: The press release does not name the authorities.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Octopus press release: it "is conducting a thorough investigation, is keeping the relevant authorities informed"; "Affected customers will be contacted by email or SMS directly."

claim_text: HK01 reports that Octopus has reported the attack to the police and notified the privacy commissioner and the Transport and Logistics Bureau
summary: HK01 reports it understands that Octopus has reported the incident to the police and notified Hong Kong's privacy commissioner and the Transport and Logistics Bureau.
detail: Octopus's own release says only that it is keeping "the relevant authorities" informed. No statement from the police or the privacy commissioner about this incident has been found.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: HK01, Nov 27 (in Chinese): "It is understood that Octopus has reported the case to the police and has notified the Office of the Privacy Commissioner for Personal Data and the Transport and Logistics Bureau."
notes: Attributed by HK01 to unnamed sources ("it is understood").

claim_text: Octopus has not said how the attackers got in, who they were, or whether data was copied out
summary: Octopus has not said how the attack happened, which system was reached, who was behind it, or whether the information was copied out of its systems. No credible outlet has reported any group claiming the attack.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: The press release gives no method, system, attacker or word on copying. The Standard and HK01 report none either.

claim_text: Octopus asks customers to watch for suspicious calls, messages, emails and links that claim to be from Octopus
summary: Octopus asks customers to watch for unusual account activity and to be cautious of suspicious calls, SMS messages, emails or links claiming to represent it, and not to give out personal, account or verification details.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Octopus press release: customers should "be cautious of suspicious calls, SMS messages, emails or links" and "should not disclose any personal, account or verification information."

claim_text: The Octopus card is Hong Kong's contactless stored-value card, used by most of the population for transport and shopping
summary: The Octopus card is a contactless stored-value smart card used in Hong Kong since 1997 for public transport fares and everyday purchases. Wikipedia says it was used by 98 percent of people aged 15 to 64 in 2016.
detail: It is owned and operated by Octopus Cards Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of Octopus Holdings Limited.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: Wikipedia: a "reusable contactless stored value smart card" for electronic payments in Hong Kong, launched in September 1997; "owned and operated by Octopus Cards Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of Octopus Holdings Limited".
